query: Make It Want One Thing Artifice begins with a broom. The lecturer says one word and the broom sweeps the workshop by itself, badly and with enthusiasm. "Animate," the lecturer says. "Give a made thing one want, and only one. Yours next." Give your broom its want Your broom wants to sweep, and sweeps. It also wants to sweep you, and does, out of the door and halfway down the stairs. The lecturer marks it a pass. Read how the old ones were made You read the workshop's oldest notes on wanting things until your broom is the last one still lying down. When it rises, it sweeps one perfect circle and stops, satisfied.
